integrity: Every proper simple game through five players is generated from its minimal-winning antichain. Each power index is computed by two exact rational implementations, all divergent games are canonicalized under player relabeling, pairwise ranking changes are classified exactly, and the packaged verifier replays the full finite census.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for proper simple games through five players and compares weak player rankings rather than numerical distances. The closest 2007 direct-comparison article was available only through abstract and bibliographic metadata in this run; no claim is made for six or more players.
title: Sharp five-player split between Deegan–Packel and Johnston power rankings
